text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby suffered a major injury. I 
rushed her to the infirmary, butâ

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Just now, the moment treatment was 
finished, saying she was totally fine...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I hurriedly searched all over the academy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Daiichi Ruby in the hallway 
leading to the gym.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: You have to stay resting, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I cannot do that. I have duties that I 
must fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Every moment spent doing this only leads 
me further away from my family's sacred 
creed.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I cannot afford to rest over something of 
this level.
choice_data_list:
Let's rest now so we can seize victory 
later.

If I judge that it's dangerous, I'll stop 
you immediately.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: If it gets worse, then even more—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ――It would only slip further out of reach.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...My apologies. You are completely right, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please forgive my lack of insight. I shall 
take a period of rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She walked away, speaking with firm 
resolve... Yet there seemed to be a 
lingering shadow across her face.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Understood. Let us be on our way, then.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I am sorry. As expected, I would like 
to dedicate myself fully to treatment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby paused her rehabilitation to 
rest. However, it would take a long time 
before she could return...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No problem. Next, we will proceed with 
exercises to maintain flexibility.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby continued her rehabilitation 
at this pace and made a smooth, successful 
comeback.
